heading: What’s inside, for restaurants
title: The same system, built for how guests choose where to eat.

items.name: Weekly Pulse
items.text: A one page read on how your restaurant showed up this week, and the one thing to do next.

items.name: Lift Score
items.text: One number that shows whether your restaurant is getting easier to find in your area.

items.name: AI Shortlist
items.text: Know whether AI assistants recommend you when people ask where to eat, and who they name instead.

items.name: Map Reach
items.text: Where your restaurant appears in Google Maps across the neighborhoods your guests come from.

items.name: Site Read
items.text: Make sure Google and AI tools describe your menu, hours and services correctly.

items.name: Daily Presence
items.text: Fresh posts that show off your food, drinks and specials, written in your voice.

items.name: Market Survey
items.text: See what nearby restaurants are doing before it costs you a table.

items.name: Review Desk
items.text: Review replies in your voice that turn happy guests into proof for the next one.

items.name: Snapshot
items.text: Calls, menu clicks and direction requests from Google, in plain language.

items.name: ClearView
items.text: Your social report: what posted, what people engaged with and what changes next.
